slides.say: Passing an object with a function through context? Every render of the provider re-renders all readers.
This object, and the login function inside, are new on every render of MyApp. So every useContext reader re-renders, even if the user did not change.
Wrap the function in use callback and the object in use memo. Now readers re-render only when current user changes.

slides.text: Small apps rarely need it. It’s a performance optimization.
slides.say: In smaller apps this is not a problem. It is a performance optimization.
